description: This file defines data classes related to problem-solving steps and payloads for a Flutter application. It includes classes such as ProblemStep and ProblemPayload, along with some constants and helper functions.

classes.name: ProblemStep
classes.description: Represents a single step in a solution walkthrough with a title and body.

classes.name: ProblemPayload
classes.description: Contains the problem statement, source info, confidence level, and list of steps. Includes a static method for creating an instance from a dynamic data source.

methods.name: ProblemPayload.fromDynamic
methods.description: Creates a ProblemPayload instance from a dynamic data source, such as a Map, with fallback defaults.
